name: SikaBond® PVA
summary: SikaBond® PVA is a cross linked waterbased adhesive suitable for interior and exterior applications. It is an ideal adhesive for bonding a wide range of timber components including tongue and groove, solid timber, laminated flooring and most porous substrates. SikaBond® PVA forms a tough permanent bond and makes it ideal for use by trades, carpenters and DIY.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Twelve (12) months from its date of production

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and out of direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: For optimum adhesion the substrates must be clean, dry, sound and free from oils, grease, dust, loose or friable particles.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use detergent and water.

rel.t: SOLVENT BASED GUN GRADE WALLBOARD ADHESIVE
rel.s: Sika® Showerbond is a solvent based, fast grab, gun grade adhesive. It has been specifically formulated for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to unpainted gypsum plasterboard,
a: Will not damage acrylic plastic shower liners
Panels can be relocated for up to 30 minutes after positioning
Excellent adhesion to most common building materials

rel.s: SikaBond® INSTANT NAILS FAST is a premium, gap filling, water based, multi purpose construction adhesive providing strong initial grab and high bond strength.
a: Reduces number of mechanical fasteners required to install floors or walls.
May be repositioned for up to 60 minutes after application
Reduces squeaking and nail ride in floors

rel.s: SSikaBond® TechGrip is a high strength multipurpose, polyurethane glue that provides a super strong bond to most common substrates and is ideal for woodworking and project work.
a: Paintable with water based and solvent based paints

rel.s: SikaBond®-115 Max Tack is a 1-part construction adhesive with high final strength which bonds most construction material substrates. Internal and sheltered outdoor use.
